svg.title: Local sports
svg.desc: Every 30 minutes the plugin's sync service asks the sidecar for the week's games; the sidecar's sports schedule reads each team's schedule from ESPN and matches the broadcasts to your stations, and when the games changed the plugin has Jellyfin refresh the guide, which then shows each game. Every minute the sidecar resolves the stream of any station airing a game, from 15 minutes before the start. When a viewer tunes in to Local Sports, the sidecar plays the station airing the game, or an off-air card between games. Every 30 minutes, check the games: 1. SyncService calls app.js: GET /api/sports. 2. app.js calls sports.js: games this week. 3. sports.js calls ESPN API: team schedule. 4. ESPN API replies to sports.js: games + TV. 5. sports.js replies to app.js: matched games. 6. app.js replies to SyncService: upcoming games. Only if the games changed: 7. SyncService sends to Jellyfin Live TV: refresh guide. 8. Jellyfin Live TV calls app.js: GET /guide.xml. 9. app.js replies to Jellyfin Live TV: game under Sports. Every minute, warm up the stream: 10. app.js calls sports.js: on air now?. 11. sports.js replies to app.js: game stations. 12. app.js calls resolver.js: resolve early. 13. resolver.js replies to app.js: fresh stream URL. A viewer tunes in to Local Sports: 14. Jellyfin Live TV calls app.js: tune Local Sports. If a game is on: 15a. app.js replies to Jellyfin Live TV: the station's stream. Otherwise: 15b. app.js replies to Jellyfin Live TV: off-air card.
